name: MiG-21bis Fishbed-L
description: Supersonic second-generation delta-wing interceptor. Highly agile in gunfights with impressive Mach 2 acceleration.

name: F-15C Eagle
description: Twin-engine all-weather air superiority fighter. Unmatched combat record with over 100 victories and zero losses.

name: MiG-29 Fulcrum-A
description: Twin-engine air superiority fighter with leading-edge root extensions. Renowned for off-boresight R-73 missile lethality.

name: Su-27 Flanker-B
description: Heavy long-range air superiority fighter renowned for the Cobra maneuver. Superb high-angle-of-attack maneuverability and heavy payload.

name: F-22A Raptor
description: Premier stealth air superiority fighter with 2D thrust vectoring nozzles. Supercruises at Mach 1.82 with unparalleled radar stealth.

name: Su-57 Felon
description: Fifth-generation stealth multirole fighter equipped with 3D thrust vectoring. Supercruise capable with extreme post-stall supermaneuverability.

name: F-16C Fighting Falcon
description: Lightweight multirole fighter with fly-by-wire flight control. Combines 9g turn capability with excellent roll response.

name: F-15E Strike Eagle
description: Dual-role strike fighter designed for long-range, high-speed interdiction. Carries massive ordnance payloads while retaining air combat prowess.

name: F/A-18C Hornet
description: Carrier-capable supersonic multirole combat jet. Exceptional high-AoA nose pointing and versatile carrier strike capability.

name: Eurofighter Typhoon
description: Twin-engine canard delta multirole fighter engineered for extreme instantaneous turn agility. Armed with Meteor BVR ramjet missiles and BK-27 cannon.

name: Mirage 2000-5
description: French tailless delta multirole fighter with fly-by-wire agility. Armed with twin DEFA 30mm cannons and versatile MICA missiles.

name: F-35A Lightning II
description: Fifth-generation stealth multirole strike fighter with advanced sensor fusion. Features the most powerful single jet engine in military aviation.

name: A-10C Thunderbolt II
description: Twin-turbofan dedicated close air support aircraft built around the devastating GAU-8 Avenger 30mm rotary cannon. Heavily armored titanium bathtub cockpit.

name: F-14B Tomcat
description: Variable-sweep wing fleet defense interceptor. Armed with long-range AIM-54 Phoenix missiles for BVR dominance.

name: Saab JA 37 Viggen
description: Swedish canard delta interceptor designed for short runway dispersal operations. Fitted with a powerful afterburning turbofan with thrust reverser.

name: Messerschmitt Bf 109 K-4
description: Final wartime production variant of the iconic German fighter. Features incredible climb rates and high-altitude energy fighting power.

name: P-51D Mustang
description: Legendary long-range piston fighter powered by the Packard Merlin V-12 engine. Outstanding speed, range, and high-altitude escort performance.

name: Supermarine Spitfire Mk IX
description: Iconic British fighter renowned for its beautiful elliptical wing and tight turning circle. Powered by the supercharged Rolls-Royce Merlin engine.

name: Boeing B-17G Flying Fortress
description: Four-engine heavy strategic bomber known for rugged survivability and heavy defensive armament. Dropped more ordnance than any other US aircraft in WWII.

name: Northrop B-2 Spirit
description: Stealth flying-wing strategic bomber that carries precision and gravity munitions in internal bays, keeping its radar signature low until it reaches the target. Four non-afterburning turbofans give it subsonic speed and intercontinental range.

name: AH-64D Apache Longbow
description: Twin-turboshaft attack helicopter featuring a mast-mounted fire-control radar. Armed with Hellfire anti-armor missiles and a 30mm chain gun.
